title: 第21章 英雄和对策求月票第22章 蟾光
content_zh:
听闻方掌柜那略显“狂妄”
的话，王道一瞬间便判断出对方是在用言语扰乱自己的心神，好让自己心生绝望，削弱自己抵抗的意志。
但方掌柜却是弄巧成拙了……
王道一作为身经百战、经验丰富的“神通境”
剑侠，哪会被这种小伎俩动摇？反而让他窥出了对方的虚实。
于是王道一眼睛微眯，继而哈哈大笑道：
“你也不用在这里虚张声势，这尊不完整的‘道孽’既然是我王道一的影子所化，那就意味着我伤得有多重，他的伤也就同样有多重！
“或者说，我现在的伤势怕是有一大半都是自己打出来的……
“而你……如果真能承受那位地祇所化‘诡异’的‘神通’层次力量，就不需要误导你的本体，将我诓骗至镜村了。”
说到这里，王道一扫了眼不知什么时候出现于天守阁内，并向自己围拢过来的诡异村民们，轻蔑道，
“至于‘神通’之下，哪怕王某再如何重伤，也是不会放在眼里的。”
方掌柜指了指身边兀自啃食着断臂，对其他事都不管不顾的“道孽”
版王道之，面无表情地道：“但王兄怕是忘了，有吾主赐予的威能加身，他不会消亡，但你会！”
王道之闻言却再次笑道：“没有什么是不会消亡的！
就算是‘大凶’级的妖邪，理论上不死不灭的存在，也有被道君斩杀的记录。
“另外，你坐在棺木前不动，也是因为只有那里能得到‘诡异’泄露出的力量庇护，不至于被我一剑斩杀吧？
“看来对于那‘诡异’来说，你也是极为重要的棋子！
“让我猜猜……大概是因为用我的影子化作的‘道孽’在吃了我补完自身后，要承担承接那‘诡异’力量和精神的任务，继而打开那件八卦镜法宝的封印，所以没有被赋予智慧吧？
“而方掌柜你是它的操纵者？啧，这么说来，你和那‘地祇’化作的‘诡异’关系应该很紧密……
“我明白了，当初将那地祇吸引过来的仪轨的主持者恐怕就是你……某种意义上，你是它的眷者！

“不过，我现在对那个将仪轨布置方法授予你们的云游僧人很是好奇，他的目的到底是什么？
“如果是包藏祸心，故意让地祇堕落成诡异，那又为什么要用这么强大的宝物将其封印在镜中世界，让其无法归来？”
方掌柜没有回答王道之的问题，只是露出一个阴森的笑容，冷声道：“王兄，你很聪明，但却也恰恰被这份聪明所误……你真以为我只是在单纯用语言动摇你的信心？”
“我知道，你想拖延时间嘛……”
王道之用手中长剑斜指刚啃完手臂，口中满是鲜血的“道孽”
，笑着道，“它没有智慧，只有野兽的本能，在发现对我造成伤害它自己也会受伤后，自然不肯再动手……哪怕是你也无法强行让它行动。
“所以，你只能等它啃完我的手，等它对我身体的渴求压过怕受伤的本能……
“我说的可对？
“但巧合的是，你在拖延时间，我也同样需要时间来稳定伤势，准备神通！”
话音未落，他手中的长剑便腾空而起，接着分化作无数道阴风、心风、朔风、罡风，共同组成了一座剑阵，将天守阁的镜面入口彻底封堵起来。
这是七品神通“神风斩魂剑阵”
“你要做什么？”
方掌柜勃然变色。
“做什么？自然是趁着你们这些妖邪眷属齐聚于此，用阵法将你们封堵在这层镜界里！
等我找人报告都护府，自然有‘洞玄’或‘升玄’的真人、真君们来料理八卦铜镜内封印的地祇诡异！”
content_en:
I heard that shopkeeper Fang was a bit "arrogant"
Wang Dao instantly judged that the other party was using words to disturb his mind, so as to make him despair and weaken his will to resist.
But shopkeeper Fang was self-defeating...
Wang Daoyi, as a "supernatural power realm" who has experienced hundreds of battles and has rich experience,
How could the swordsman be swayed by such a little trick? On the contrary, it allowed him to see the other party's true nature.
So Wang Daoyi narrowed his eyes, then laughed loudly and said:
"You don't need to bluff here. Since this incomplete 'Dao Evil' is the shadow of my king Daoyi, it means that no matter how severe my injury is, his injury will be equally severe!
"In other words, I am afraid that most of my current injuries are caused by myself...
"And you...if you can really withstand the 'weird' level of 'supernatural power' transformed by that earth creature, there will be no need to mislead your body and trick me into the Mirror Village."
Having said this, Wang Dao glanced at the strange villagers who appeared in the castle tower at an unknown time and surrounded him, and said contemptuously,
"As for the 'supernatural power', even if Wang is seriously injured, he will not take it seriously."
Shopkeeper Fang pointed at the "evil" beside him who was chewing on a severed arm and not caring about anything else.
Ban Wangdaozhi said expressionlessly: "But I'm afraid Brother Wang has forgotten that with the power given by my Lord, he will not die, but you will!"
Wang Daozhi laughed again when he heard this: "Nothing will perish!
Even the 'big evil' level demons, theoretically immortal beings, have records of being beheaded by Dao Lord.
"In addition, the reason why you are sitting in front of the coffin without moving is because it is the only place where you can get the protection of the power leaked by the 'weird', so that you will not be killed by my sword, right?
"It seems that you are also an extremely important chess piece for that 'weird' one!
"Let me guess... It's probably because the 'Dao Evil' transformed from my shadow, after eating me to replenish itself, has to undertake the task of inheriting the 'weird' power and spirit, and then opens the seal of the Bagua Mirror magic weapon, so it is not endowed with wisdom, right?
"And Shopkeeper Fang, you are its controller? Tsk, so to speak, you should have a very close relationship with the 'weird' creature that the 'earth creature' transformed into..."
"I understand, I'm afraid you were the person in charge of the ritual that attracted that land here... In a sense, you are its favored one!
"However, I am now very curious about the wandering monk who gave you the ritual arrangement method. What is his purpose?
"If he had evil intentions and deliberately caused the earth to become strange, then why did he use such a powerful treasure to seal it in the mirror world so that it could not return? "
Shopkeeper Fang did not answer Wang Daozhi's question, but showed a sinister smile and said coldly: "Brother Wang, you are very smart, but you are also misled by this smartness... Do you really think I am just using words to shake your confidence? "
"I know, you want to delay time..."
Wang Daozhi pointed his long sword at the "Dao evil" who had just finished chewing his arm, and his mouth was full of blood.
, smiled and said, "It has no intelligence, only the instinct of a beast. After discovering that it will hurt itself if it hurts me, it naturally refuses to do anything again... Even you can't force it to move."
"So, you can only wait for it to finish chewing my hand, and wait for its desire for my body to overwhelm its instinct of fear of injury...
"Am I right?
"But coincidentally, you are stalling for time, and I also need time to stabilize my injuries and prepare my magical powers!"
Before he finished speaking, the long sword in his hand rose into the air, and then divided into countless Yin wind, Xinfeng, Shuofeng and Gangfeng, which together formed a sword array and completely blocked the mirror entrance of the castle tower.
This is the seventh-grade magical power "Divine Wind Soul-Slaying Sword Formation"
"What are you going to do?"
Shopkeeper Fang suddenly changed his color.
"What to do? Of course, while you are hereSome evil spirits have gathered here and used formations to block you in this mirror world!
When I find someone to report to the Protectorate, there will naturally be real people and real kings from 'Dongxuan' or 'Shengxuan' who will come to take care of the strange things sealed in the Bagua Bronze Mirror! "
